<h2 id="-近期工作-1">📌 近期工作 1</h2>
<h3 id="uber-unsupervised-behavior-extraction-via-random-intent-priors-neurips-2023">(UBER) Unsupervised Behavior Extraction via Random Intent Priors [NeurIPS 2023]</h3>
<ul>
<li>arxiv：<a href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2310.18687" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://arxiv.org/abs/2310.18687</a></li>
<li>pdf：<a href="https://arxiv.org/pdf/2310.18687" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://arxiv.org/pdf/2310.18687</a></li>
<li>html：<a href="https://ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org/html/2310.18687" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org/html/2310.18687</a></li>
<li>来源：师兄的工作，NeurIPS 2023。感谢师弟的讲解。</li>
<li>参考博客：直接看这个好了，<a href="https://blog.csdn.net/iiiiii11/article/details/155364242" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">CSDN | 【论文阅读笔记】UBER：用随机意图从无奖励数据中提取有用行为</a></li>
</ul>
<p>主要内容：</p>
<ul>
<li>setting：我们拿到了 single-task 的没有 reward 的 offline 数据集，现在想基于这个数据集，学出来可以做相关 task 的策略。</li>
<li>method：直接给这个数据集标注 N 个随机 reward，然后训出来 N 个策略，最后使用 PEX 方法进行 offline-to-online。</li>
<li>理论（根据印象 可能有幻觉）：
<ul>
<li>Proposition 4.1 指的是，给定一个 policy，总能构造出来一个 reward，使得这个 policy 是这个 reward 下的最优 policy 之一。</li>
<li>Theorem 4.2 指的是，只要目标行为在数据集中有较好的覆盖，我们就能有效地学习它。使用大小为 N 的 offline dataset，这样学出来的最好性能与 optimal policy 的差距，可以被 N bound 住。使用了 linear MDP 和 PEVI 那一套，我不懂这些理论。</li>
<li>Theorem 4.3 好像指的是，UBER 使用的构造 random reward 的方法可以离 true reward 足够近，是使用岭回归（ridge regression）来证明的，岭回归 我也不懂。</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>实验：做了 d4rl 和 metaworld。还没仔细看。搬运参考博客的内容：</li>
</ul>
<blockquote>
<p>结果 1：随机意图确实产生多样且高质量行为。实验显示，UBER提取的行为策略：</p>
<ul>
<li>性能超越原始数据：特别是在原始数据质量不高时</li>
<li>分布更加多样：回报分布的熵值显著高于原始数据集和行为克隆方法</li>
</ul>
<p>结果 2：在线学习加速显著。在Mujoco运动任务中，UBER相比基线方法：</p>
<ul>
<li>学习速度更快：在相同环境步数下获得更高回报</li>
<li>最终性能更好：在多数任务中达到或接近专家水平</li>
</ul>
<p>结果3：跨任务迁移能力。在 Meta-World 的多任务实验中，UBER 学到的行为策略能够成功迁移到不同的下游任务，证明了其跨任务泛化能力。可能的原因是，随机奖励产生了通用运动原语（如"接近物体"、“精确控制末端执行器”），这些原语在不同任务间可迁移。</p>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="entropy-regularized-task-representation-learning-for-offline-meta-reinforcement-learning-aaai-2025">Entropy Regularized Task Representation Learning for Offline Meta-Reinforcement Learning [AAAI 2025]</h3>
<ul>
<li>arxiv：<a href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.14834" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.14834</a></li>
<li>GitHub：<a href="https://github.com/MohammadrezaNakhaei/ER-TRL" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/MohammadrezaNakhaei/ER-TRL</a></li>
<li>来源：之前的速读，AAAI 2025。</li>
<li>参考博客：<a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/moonout/p/18627106#entropy-regularized-task-representation-learning-for-offline-meta-reinforcement-learning" target="_blank">论文速读记录 | 2024.12</a></li>
</ul>
<p>主要内容：</p>
<ul>
<li>task encoder <span class="math inline">\(e(z|c)\)</span> 可能会耦合 behavior policy <span class="math inline">\(\pi_\beta\)</span>（即生成 offline dataset 的那些 policy）的信息，导致 inference 时，当 agent 遇到 OOD 的 transition 时，encoder 无法推断出正确的 task。</li>
<li>为此，我们希望去最小化 task encoder <span class="math inline">\(e(z|c)\)</span> 和 behavior policy <span class="math inline">\(\pi_\beta\)</span> 之间的互信息；通过一个 GAN 来模拟 behavior policy <span class="math inline">\(\pi_\beta\)</span>，其中 generator 用来生成以假乱真的 action， discriminator 用来区分真假 action。</li>
<li>最小化这个互信息，好像等于最大化 <span class="math inline">\(H(\pi_\beta | p(z_i))\)</span> 的熵；具体细节还没看。</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="robust-task-representations-for-offline-meta-reinforcement-learning-via-contrastive-learning-icml-2022">Robust Task Representations for Offline Meta-Reinforcement Learning via Contrastive Learning [ICML 2022]</h3>
<ul>
<li>arxiv：<a href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2206.10442" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://arxiv.org/abs/2206.10442</a></li>
<li>pdf：<a href="https://arxiv.org/pdf/2206.10442" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://arxiv.org/pdf/2206.10442</a></li>
<li>html：<a href="https://ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org/html/2206.10442" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org/html/2206.10442</a></li>
<li>来源：无意中搜到的，ICML 2022。</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="meta-dt-offline-meta-rl-as-conditional-sequence-modeling-with-world-model-disentanglement-neurips-2024">Meta-DT: Offline Meta-RL as Conditional Sequence Modeling with World Model Disentanglement [NeurIPS 2024]</h3>
<ul>
<li>arxiv：<a href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.11448" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.11448</a></li>
<li>pdf：<a href="https://arxiv.org/pdf/2410.11448" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://arxiv.org/pdf/2410.11448</a></li>
<li>html：<a href="https://arxiv.org/html/2410.11448v2" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://arxiv.org/html/2410.11448v2</a></li>
<li>来源：看起来是使用 DT 的 offline meta-RL，NeurIPS 2024。</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="towards-an-information-theoretic-framework-of-context-based-offline-meta-reinforcement-learning-neurips-2024">Towards an Information Theoretic Framework of Context-Based Offline Meta-Reinforcement Learning [NeurIPS 2024]</h3>
<ul>
<li>arxiv：</li>
<li>好像是提出了一个统一的框架，来总结现有的 offline meta-RL 方法。</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="skill-based-meta-reinforcement-learning-iclr-2022">Skill-based Meta-Reinforcement Learning [ICLR 2022]</h3>
<ul>
<li>arxiv：<a href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2204.11828" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://arxiv.org/abs/2204.11828</a></li>
<li>看起来是使用跟 skill 有关的方法，从 offline dataset 里学一个 meta 策略。</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="scrutinize-what-we-ignore-reining-in-task-representation-shift-of-context-based-offline-meta-reinforcement-learning-iclr-2025">Scrutinize What We Ignore: Reining In Task Representation Shift Of Context-Based Offline Meta Reinforcement Learning [ICLR 2025]</h3>
<ul>
<li>arxiv：<a href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2405.12001" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://arxiv.org/abs/2405.12001</a></li>
<li>有可能有点相关。</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="generalizable-task-representation-learning-for-offline-meta-reinforcement-learning-with-data-limitations-aaai-2024">Generalizable Task Representation Learning for Offline Meta-Reinforcement Learning with Data Limitations [AAAI 2024]</h3>
<ul>
<li>arxiv：</li>
<li>有可能有点相关，是 OMRL 的最新工作。</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="provably-improved-context-based-offline-meta-rl-with-attention-and-contrastive-learning-iclr-2022">Provably Improved Context-Based Offline Meta-RL with Attention and Contrastive Learning [ICLR 2022]</h3>
<ul>
<li>arxiv：<a href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2102.10774" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://arxiv.org/abs/2102.10774</a></li>
<li>pdf：<a href="https://arxiv.org/pdf/2102.10774" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://arxiv.org/pdf/2102.10774</a></li>
<li>html：<a href="https://ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org/html/2102.10774" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org/html/2102.10774</a></li>
<li>来源：ICLR 2022。好像改进了 focal，使用任务内部的 attention 机制和任务间的对比学习，根据论文标题，还有理论证明。</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="uds-how-to-leverage-unlabeled-data-in-offline-reinforcement-learning-icml-2022">(UDS) How to Leverage Unlabeled Data in Offline Reinforcement Learning [ICML 2022]</h3>
<ul>
<li>arxiv：<a href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2202.01741" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://arxiv.org/abs/2202.01741</a></li>
<li>pdf：<a href="https://arxiv.org/pdf/2202.01741" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://arxiv.org/pdf/2202.01741</a></li>
<li>html：<a href="https://ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org/html/2202.01741" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org/html/2202.01741</a></li>
<li>来源：ICML 2022。跟我们关注的 setting 是像的，都关注没有 reward label 的 offline 数据集。好像直接拿 zero reward 来作为 reward。</li>
</ul>
<p>好像基于 CDS 和 UDS，但听说这两个方法不太可复现。</p>
<h2 id="-近期工作-2">📌 近期工作 2</h2>
<h3 id="idaq-offline-meta-reinforcement-learning-with-in-distribution-online-adaptation-icml-2023">(IDAQ) Offline Meta Reinforcement Learning with In-Distribution Online Adaptation [ICML 2023]</h3>
<ul>
<li>arxiv：<a href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.19529" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.19529</a></li>
<li>pdf：<a href="https://arxiv.org/pdf/2305.19529" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://arxiv.org/pdf/2305.19529</a></li>
<li>html：<a href="https://ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org/html/2305.19529" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org/html/2305.19529</a></li>
<li>来源：师弟推荐的工作，ICML 2023。</li>
<li>参考博客：<a href="https://blog.csdn.net/iiiiii11/article/details/155364351" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">CSDN |【论文阅读笔记】IDAQ：离线元强化学习中的分布内在线适应</a></li>
<li>（就算有博客，也还是看不太懂，一是不太了解 multi-task 的具体 setting，二是不太能 get 到 offline 他们讲的 distribution shift 故事…… 找时间好好学一下，可能先看看 focal</li>
<li>baseline：FOCAL、MACAW、BOReL。</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="context-shift-reduction-for-offline-meta-reinforcement-learning-neurips-2023">Context Shift Reduction for Offline Meta-Reinforcement Learning [NeurIPS 2023]</h3>
<ul>
<li>arxiv：<a href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.03695" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.03695</a></li>
<li>感觉想解决的问题，好像跟 IDAQ 是类似的，都是去 address offline dataset 和我们真正 rollout 出来的数据的分布不一致。</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="text-to-decision-agent-offline-meta-reinforcement-learning-from-natural-language-supervision-neurips-2025">Text-to-Decision Agent: Offline Meta-Reinforcement Learning from Natural Language Supervision [NeurIPS 2025]</h3>
<ul>
<li>arxiv：<a href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.15046" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.15046</a></li>
<li>看起来是最新的结合 LLM 的 offline meta-RL 工作。</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="efficient-offline-meta-reinforcement-learning-via-robust-task-representations-and-adaptive-policy-generation-ijcai-2024">Efficient Offline Meta-Reinforcement Learning via Robust Task Representations and Adaptive Policy Generation [IJCAI 2024]</h3>
<ul>
<li>可以看 abstract 的网页：<a href="https://dl.acm.org/doi/10.24963/ijcai.2024/500" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://dl.acm.org/doi/10.24963/ijcai.2024/500</a></li>
<li>pdf：<a href="https://www.ijcai.org/proceedings/2024/0500.pdf" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://www.ijcai.org/proceedings/2024/0500.pdf</a></li>
<li>来源：无意中搜到的，IJCAI 2024。看 abstract 感觉解决的不是很重要的问题，但好像是有趣的，不着急看。</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="meta-reinforcement-learning-via-exploratory-task-clustering-aaai-2024">Meta-Reinforcement Learning via Exploratory Task Clustering [AAAI 2024]</h3>
<ul>
<li>arxiv：<a href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2302.07958" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://arxiv.org/abs/2302.07958</a></li>
<li>pdf：<a href="https://arxiv.org/pdf/2302.07958" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://arxiv.org/pdf/2302.07958</a></li>
<li>html：<a href="https://ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org/html/2302.07958" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org/html/2302.07958</a></li>
<li>来源：师弟的论文 list，AAAI 2024。看 abstract 感觉没有解决特别重要的问题，但因为是 task clustering，所以想看一下。</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="contextual-transformer-for-offline-meta-reinforcement-learning-neurips-2022-workshop">Contextual Transformer for Offline Meta Reinforcement Learning [NeurIPS 2022 workshop]</h3>
<ul>
<li>arxiv：<a href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2211.08016" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://arxiv.org/abs/2211.08016</a></li>
<li>是 workshop 文章。简单看看吧。</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="model-based-offline-meta-reinforcement-learning-with-regularization">Model-Based Offline Meta-Reinforcement Learning with Regularization</h3>
<ul>
<li>arxiv：<a href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2202.02929" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://arxiv.org/abs/2202.02929</a></li>
<li>model-based 的 offline meta-RL。</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="enhancing-online-reinforcement-learning-with-meta-learned-objective-from-offline-data-aaai-2025">Enhancing Online Reinforcement Learning with Meta-Learned Objective from Offline Data [AAAI 2025]</h3>
<ul>
<li>arxiv：</li>
<li>可能有一点相关。</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="offline-meta-reinforcement-learning-with-online-self-supervision-icml-2022">Offline Meta-Reinforcement Learning with Online Self-Supervision [ICML 2022]</h3>
<ul>
<li>arxiv：<a href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2107.03974" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://arxiv.org/abs/2107.03974</a></li>
<li>pdf：<a href="https://arxiv.org/pdf/2107.03974" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://arxiv.org/pdf/2107.03974</a></li>
<li>html：<a href="https://ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org/html/2107.03974" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org/html/2107.03974</a></li>
<li>来源：疑似是 offline meta-RL + offline-to-online 的文章，ICML 2022。感觉不着急读。</li>
</ul>
